comment: Species representing proteins or their activity states were mapped to the underlying protein (e.g., ATM, ATR, TP53, CHEK1/2, HDAC4, TOPBP1, NFE2L2, KEAP1, PP2A, SET/I2PP2A, BAX, PUMA, p21). Small-molecule drugs were assigned as chemicals (Omaveloxolone, Spermidine). Abstract/process states and the generic DNA damage species were labeled as unknown. The PP2A_I2PP2A species was treated as a complex containing PP2A and I2PP2A (SET). Where possible common gene/protein synonyms (up to three) are provided.
